source_row.rationale: Radon, a naturally occurring, colorless, odorless radioactive gas that can accumulate in homes (particularly basements or lower levels), is a leading cause of lung cancer after smoking. Since it cannot be detected by human senses, home testing (using widely available test kits) is an important preventive measure to identify elevated levels and take mitigation action if needed.
